name: Chemtech Industrial Valves Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1997, Chemtech Industrial Valves Ltd manufactures lndustrial Valves and trades various items for project sale[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is in the business of manufacturing industrial valves, ranging from manually operated shut-off valves to automated control valves, and from single valves to complex modular products

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 48.6% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 13.4% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.5.22 Cr.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -31.2%
